item.title: Captain Carter

e: A Celestial's emergence breaks Earth apart, and Riri Williams fights Quentin Beck's regime with a hidden resistance.
Daimon Helstrom teaches ethics and hunts demons.
Ana Helstrom runs an auction house as cover while she hunts killers.
Former Marine Steve Rogers is saved by a serum his father created and becomes Captain America.
Captain America II: Death Too Soon
Steve Rogers stops a general holding a city hostage with an aging drug.
Monica Rambeau wakes stranded in another universe, where Binary, this world's Maria Rambeau, and Beast look after her.

item.title: Kahhori

e: Bruce's attempt to rid himself of the Hulk creates the Apex, and years later Sam Wilson's Mech Avengers fight it in New York.
Peter Parker starts an internship at Oscorp, where Norman Osborn shows him footage proving he knows Peter is Spider-Man.
Frank Castle goes to war with the mobster who becomes Jigsaw.

item.title: The Hydra Stomper
rows: Steve Rogers: Lost with the Tesseract
Black Widow: The Red Room Files

e: Surgeon Stephen Strange is trained by the Ancient One.
Four siblings given powers by an alien fight crime while keeping it from their parents.
Howard is pulled from his world of ducks to Cleveland and stops a Dark Overlord of the Universe.
Captain Carter is pulled into 1602 England, where King Thor rules and an outlaw named Rogers Hood turns out to be Steve Rogers, lost in time.
Strange Supreme catches up with Peggy Carter here and agrees to help her get home, taking her to his Sanctum Infinitum.
Miles and Gwen help Pavitr Prabhakar fight the Spot, and Miles saves a man whose death was a canon event.
Spider-Man sends a metal-eating robot into the river, then stops the Green Goblin from calling up demons with a stolen book of witchcraft.
In Florida, Spider-Man learns of Dr. Connors's swamp fever research, fights the Lizard in a ruined Spanish fort, and turns him back into Connors.
In Florida, Spider-Man finds Dr. Connors held prisoner in the old Spanish fort, where a conquistador guards a Fountain of Youth.
An alligator made intelligent by Dr. Connors's experiments kidnaps him to rule the swamps, until Spider-Man turns the serum against it.
Dr. Noah Boddy breaks the Green Goblin, Electro and the Vulture out of prison, and Spider-Man tricks them into fighting each other at the docks.
A Spider-Man from 2099, Miguel O'Hara, drops into this universe and ends up in a finger-pointing argument with its Spider-Man.
Peter takes a job at the Daily Bugle to pay for Aunt May's medicine and breaks up the Kingpin's fake medicine ring, saving Jameson and the Bugle.
The Master Technician lifts Manhattan into the sky for ransom, until Spider-Man beats him and he is jailed.
Captain Ned Stacy rescues the injured Spider-Man, who then saves him from a prison breakout.
The Kingpin runs a brainwashing scheme from a Times Square nightclub, until Spider-Man foils it.
Calling himself the Radiation Specialist, the Master Technician lifts Manhattan again, and Spider-Man beats him with Captain Stacy's help.

In Old Hollywood, Agatha stars in Howard Stark's Cosmic Queen while plotting to drain Tiamut, the Celestial buried in Earth, and after she takes its power and defeats Arishem, Kingo talks her into giving it up.
Reed, Johnny, Ben and Victor make an unsanctioned trip here, and Victor is left behind when the ground erupts.
Reed hides here after escaping the government.
Graduate student Peter Parker, bitten by a radioactive spider, fights crime in New York as Spider-Man.
Kitty Pryde joins the X-Men as Magneto steers a comet toward Earth.
Peter Parker fights Doctor Doom between photo jobs for the Bugle.
Spider-Man, Iceman and Firestar share Aunt May's house, and a secret.
Bruce Banner hides the Hulk at a New Mexico army base.
Peggy Carter takes the super soldier serum, and Steve Rogers fights beside her in a suit of armor.
Peggy and Natasha find Steve inside the Hydra Stomper, brainwashed by the Red Room, and he gives his life to destroy it.
The Watcher takes Peggy from a mission aboard the Lemurian Star into the Guardians of the Multiverse, and back home she and Natasha find the Hydra Stomper armor with someone inside.
With the X-Men gone, the Strucker family goes on the run with the Mutant Underground.
Magazine editor Jessica Drew fights crime as Spider-Woman.
Red Guardian stops the Winter Soldier from killing Howard and Maria Stark, and the two go on the run together.
